panels.title: Accuracy of served forecasts (scored once their 28 days are over)
Item-level WAPE by forecast origin
panels.description: Lower is better. Each point is the forecast issued that Sunday, scored on the 28 days that followed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.date::timestamp AS time, p.wape AS "served model", p.naive_wape AS "seasonal naive",
       p.expected_wape AS "expected at promotion"
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.origin_d) p.* FROM performance p JOIN requests r USING (request_id)
           ORDER BY p.origin_d, r.created_at DESC) p JOIN calendar c ON c.d = p.origin_d ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Store total: daily WAPE and bias

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.date::timestamp AS time, p.store_wape AS "store-level WAPE", p.bias AS "bias"
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.origin_d) p.* FROM performance p JOIN requests r USING (request_id)
           ORDER BY p.origin_d, r.created_at DESC) p JOIN calendar c ON c.d = p.origin_d ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Input drift (PSI vs the champion's training reference)
panels.description: PSI above 0.25 is an alert; first monitor run of each day. Calendar features and age are not monitored: they change by design.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (m.run_d, m.subject) c.date::timestamp AS time, m.subject AS metric, m.value
FROM monitor_results m JOIN calendar c ON c.d = m.run_d
WHERE m.check_name = 'input_drift' AND m.value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.run_d, m.subject, m.run_at

SELECT c.date::text AS day, e.event AS what, coalesce('v' || e.model_version, '') AS model, e.reason AS detail
FROM model_events e JOIN calendar c ON c.d = e.at_d
UNION ALL
SELECT c.date::text, 'alert', m.check_name || ': ' || m.subject,
       coalesce(nullif(m.detail, ''), round(m.value::numeric, 3)::text)
FROM monitor_results m JOIN calendar c ON c.d = m.run_d WHERE m.status = 'alert'
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 2
